profile.summary: sheplu is a mid-level JavaScript developer with strong expertise in backend development, particularly within the Node.js ecosystem. Their contributions to the Express.js project demonstrate deep familiarity with Express.js middleware, asynchronous programming patterns (async/await, Promises), and CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions. The developer shows proficiency in dependency management, semantic versioning, and maintaining Node.js-based projects. While there is no evidence of frontend frameworks or TypeScript usage, their backend-focused contributions highlight strong skills in backend development, tooling, and modern JavaScript practices. The experience level is assessed as mid due to the breadth of contributions across multiple technical areas and the complexity of the tasks undertaken (e.g., CI/CD updates, dependency management, and Node.js versioning).
